Messages.Author: Jon Stahler
Messages.Body:
I asked this question, but the thread got WAY too long, so I'll just compose
a new message as its buried by now. The intent is NOT to start another war,
but rather find the answers to how these cards function.

What happens in the following situation:

Adonai blocks a vampire controlled by my predator and sends them to torpor.
Can another untapped minion I control with auspex play fast reaction to
enter combat with the torporized minion? Nothing on card text indicates I
can't, so I'm guessing its legal to play the card.

In this scenario, how is aggravated damage handled (assuming that I CAN
enter combat with the torporized minion)? The vampire is "wounded" since
its in torpor, correct? Would a single agg damage burn the opposing minion?
I'm guessing yes, but will wait for your response.

Would similar logic follow for a blocking minion in torpor and hidden
lurker? Again, there is no ready requirement for the opposing minion so I
didn't know how this was handled.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jon Stahler wrote:
> Adonai blocks a vampire controlled by my predator and sends them to torpor.
> Can another untapped minion I control with auspex play fast reaction to
> enter combat with the torporized minion? Nothing on card text indicates I
> can't, so I'm guessing its legal to play the card.

No. Only ready minions are legal targets of "enter combat" effects.
[6.4]
